title: 2012 年全国硕士研究生招生考试 英语（二）

sections.title: Section I　完形填空
sections.dir: Read the following text. Choose the best word(s) for each numbered blank and mark A, B, C or D on ANSWER SHEET 1. (10 points)
sections.note: 主线：G.I. Joe 从“战争玩具”还原成平民英雄。空多考搭配（up against、make it），不考生僻词。

paras.en: Millions of Americans and foreigners see G.I. Joe as a mindless war toy, the symbol of American military adventurism, but that's not how it used to be. To the men and women who 1 in World War II and the people they liberated, the G.I. was the 2 man grown into hero, the poor farm kid torn away from his home, the guy who 3 all the burdens of battle, who slept in cold foxholes, who went without the 4 of food and shelter, who stuck it out and drove back the Nazi reign of murder. This was not a volunteer soldier, not someone well paid, 5 an average guy, up 6 the best trained, best equipped, fiercest, most brutal enemies seen in centuries.
paras.zh: 数以百万计的美国人和外国人把 G.I. Joe 看作一件没有头脑的战争玩具、美国军事冒险主义的象征，但过去并非如此。对于在二战中 1 的男女士兵以及他们所解放的人们来说，G.I. 是成长为英雄的 2 人，是背井离乡的贫苦农家子弟，是 3 战争全部重担的人，是睡在冰冷散兵坑里的人，是没有食物和住所等 4 的人，是咬牙坚持、击退纳粹杀戮统治的人。他不是志愿兵，也不属于薪酬优厚者，5 一个普通人，6 着几个世纪以来训练最有素、装备最精良、最凶悍、最残忍的敌人。

paras.en: His name isn't much. G.I. is just a military abbreviation 7 Government Issue, and it was on all of the articles 8 to soldiers. And Joe? A common name for a guy who never 9 it to the top. Joe Blow, Joe Palooka, Joe Magrac...a working class name. The United States has 10 had a president or vice-president or secretary of state Joe.
paras.zh: 他的名字并不重要。G.I. 只是一个军事缩写，7“政府配发”（Government Issue），印在所有 8 给士兵的物品上。那 Joe 呢？它是那种从未 9 到顶层的普通人的常用名。Joe Blow、Joe Palooka、Joe Magrac……一个工人阶级的名字。美国 10 有过一位叫 Joe 的总统、副总统或国务卿。

paras.en: G.I. Joe had a 11 career fighting German, Japanese, and Korean troops. He appears as a character, or a 12 of American personalities, in the 1945 movie The Story of G.I. Joe, based on the last days of war correspondent Ernie Pyle. Some of the soldiers Pyle 13 portrayed themselves in the film. Pyle was famous for covering the 14 side of the war, writing about the dirt-snow-and-mud soldiers, not how many miles were 15 or what towns were captured or liberated. His reports 16 the "Willie" cartoons of famed Stars and Stripes artist Bill Maulden. Both men 17 the dirt and exhaustion of war, the 18 of civilization that the soldiers shared with each other and the civilians: coffee, tobacco, whiskey, shelter, sleep. 19 Egypt, France, and a dozen more countries, G.I. Joe was any American soldier, 20 the most important person in their lives.
paras.zh: G.I. Joe 有过一段 11 的军旅生涯，先后与德国、日本和朝鲜军队作战。在 1945 年的电影《美国大兵乔的故事》中，他以一个人物的形象出现，或者说是美国人诸多性格的 12；这部影片根据战地记者厄尼·派尔（Ernie Pyle）生命最后的日子拍成。派尔 13 过的一些士兵在片中扮演了自己。派尔以报道战争 14 的一面而闻名，他写的是满身泥土、积雪和泥浆的士兵，而不是 15 了多少英里，或者攻占、解放了哪些城镇。他的报道与《星条报》著名画家比尔·莫尔登（Bill Maulden）的“威利”系列漫画 16。两人都 17 战争的肮脏与消耗，以及士兵彼此之间、与平民之间共享的文明 18：咖啡、烟草、威士忌、住所、睡眠。19 埃及、法国以及另外十几个国家的人们，G.I. Joe 就是任何一名美国士兵，20 那时他们生活中最重要的人。

items.exp: 定位首段②句 who 1 in World War II and the people they liberated：这些人解放了别人，显然是在军中“服役”，serve 正有此义。performed 需接具体职责，rebelled（反叛）、betrayed（背叛）与“解放者”的身份完全相反。
定位同句 the 2 man grown into hero，后面 the poor farm kid、the guy who... 一路铺陈的都是出身寒微的普通人，故 common（普通的）。actual 指“真实的”，与“成长为英雄”构不成“普通人→英雄”的落差；normal 侧重“正常、无异常”，special 则相反。
定位同句 the guy who 3 all the burdens of battle，宾语是“战争的全部重担”，只能“承受”，bear 的过去式 bore 正确。loaded 是“使承载”，须用 be loaded with 的被动式；eased（减轻）、removed（清除）与“承受重担”方向相反。
定位同句 who went without the 4 of food and shelter，食物与住所是生存“必需品”，necessities 正确。facilities 指设备设施，commodities 指市场上的商品，properties 指财产房产，都不能概括 food and shelter 在战时“匮乏”的语境。
定位首段末句 not a volunteer soldier, not someone well paid, 5 an average guy：前面两个 not 与后面的“普通人”构成 not... but... 的对比，故 but。and 会把三层并列成同向，nor 需与前句否定并列且语序倒装，hence 表因果，均不通。
定位同句 up 6 the best trained, best equipped, fiercest, most brutal enemies，up against 为固定搭配，意为“面对、对抗（强敌）”。for 表目的、into 表进入、from 表来源，都无法与 up 组成“以弱对强”之意，也与 enemies 搭配不当。
定位第二段②句 G.I. is just a military abbreviation 7 Government Issue：缩写与全称之间是“意为”的关系，an abbreviation meaning... 是词典式表达。implying 指“暗示（言外之意）”，symbolizing 指“象征”，claiming 指“声称”，三者都把客观释义说成了主观行为。
定位同句 it was on all of the articles 8 to soldiers：前文已点明 G.I. 即 Government Issue（政府配发），物品自然是“发放”给士兵，hand out 正确。turned over 是移交控制权，brought back 是带回，passed down 是世代相传，都与“配发给士兵”不符。
定位第二段④句 a guy who never 9 it to the top：make it 是固定搭配，意为“获得成功、到达顶端”，make it to the top 更是常搭配。pushed it to the top 是“把它推上去”，got it to the top 缺“成功”之义，managed 后一般直接跟宾语或 to do。
定位第二段末句 The United States has 10 had a president or vice-president or secretary of state Joe：上句刚说 Joe 这类人“从未”爬到顶层，此处举例只能是否定——美国“从未”有叫 Joe 的总统，故 never。ever 多用于疑问、条件句；either/neither 表“两者”，与三个职位并列不符。
定位第三段首句 G.I. Joe had a 11 career fighting German, Japanese, and Korean troops：全文对 G.I. Joe 持肯定态度，与跟德、日、朝三军作战的战绩相配的是“卓越的”生涯，distinguished 正确。disguised（伪装的）、disturbed（受困扰的）、disputed（有争议的）都与这一正面基调冲突。
定位第三段②句 He appears as a character, or a 12 of American personalities：or 前后应为同义递进，角色身上“汇集”了美国人的种种性格，a collection of 正表“集合”。company 指陪伴，community 指社区群体，colony 指聚居群体或殖民地，都不能与 personalities 构成“性格集合”。
定位第三段③句 Some of the soldiers Pyle 13 portrayed themselves in the film：Pyle 的身份是同句前的 war correspondent（战地记者），记者对士兵自然是“采访”，interviewed 正确。employed（雇用）、appointed（任命）、questioned（审问、质疑）都不是记者的本职动作。
定位第三段④句 famous for covering the 14 side of the war，冒号后的解释是写满身泥雪的士兵，而不是行军里程与攻占城镇——关注的是“人”而非战果，故 human（人性的一面）。military 与后文“不写战果”自相矛盾，political、ethical 文中无据。
定位同句 not how many miles were 15 or what towns were captured or liberated：与 captured、liberated 并列的应是“夺取（阵地）”，gain 有“攻占、赢得”之义，故 D。ruined（毁坏）与 miles 搭配不当，commuted（通勤）、patrolled（巡逻）都无法与“多少英里”构成战果。

定位第三段⑤句 His reports 16 the "Willie" cartoons，紧接着⑥句用 Both men 17 the dirt and exhaustion of war 点明二者“相同”，故 parallel（与……相似、并行）正确。counteracted（抵消）、contradicted（相矛盾）与 Both men 的并列关系冲突，duplicated 指“复制”，程度过实。
定位第三段⑥句 Both men 17 the dirt and exhaustion of war：两人的共同点是把战争的肮脏与消耗“突出”出来，emphasized 正确。neglected、avoided 与上文“专写泥雪中的士兵”相反；admired（赞赏）不能以 the dirt and exhaustion 为宾语。

定位同句 the 18 of civilization that the soldiers shared...: coffee, tobacco, whiskey, shelter, sleep：冒号后列举的是一堆零散的日常物件，正是“文明的碎片”，fragments 正确。stages（阶段）、illusions（幻觉）、advances（进步）都无法概括“咖啡、烟草、睡眠”这类具体而微的东西。
定位末句 19 Egypt, France, and a dozen more countries, G.I. Joe was any American soldier：这是“对……而言”的判断句，To sb, ... 正表“在某人看来、对某人来说”，与首段 To the men and women who... 的句式呼应。With 表伴随，Among 表范围，Beyond 表超出，均不合。

定位同句 G.I. Joe was any American soldier, 20 the most important person in their lives：整段回顾的是“过去”的形象，过去时 was 与首句 used to be 呼应，此处意为“在那个时候”，at that point 正确。on the contrary 表相反，by this means 表方式，from the outset 表时间起点，都与“那时”不符。

sections.title: Text 1　家庭作业新规的失误
sections.dir: Read the following four texts. Answer the questions after each text by choosing A, B, C or D. Mark your answers on ANSWER SHEET 1. (40 points)
sections.note: 主线：洛杉矶学区把作业占比压到 10%，作者批其方法有误。23 题别选 C——教师布置权没被限制，被打击的是学生动力。

paras.en: Homework has never been terribly popular with students and even many parents, but in recent years it has been particularly scorned. School districts across the country, most recently Los Angeles Unified, are revising their thinking on this educational ritual. Unfortunately, L.A. Unified has produced an inflexible policy which mandates that with the exception of some advanced courses, homework may no longer count for more than 10% of a student's academic grade.
paras.zh: 家庭作业从来就不太受学生甚至许多家长的欢迎，但近几年它尤其遭到鄙弃。全国各地的学区——最近是洛杉矶联合学区——都在重新审视他们对这一教育惯例的看法。不幸的是，洛杉矶联合学区出台了一项僵硬的政策：除部分高级课程外，作业在学生学业成绩中的占比不得超过 10%。

paras.en: This rule is meant to address the difficulty that students from impoverished or chaotic homes might have in completing their homework. But the policy is unclear and contradictory. Certainly, no homework should be assigned that students cannot complete on their own or that they cannot do without expensive equipment. But if the district is essentially giving a pass to students who do not do their homework because of complicated family lives, it is going riskily close to the implication that standards need to be lowered for poor children.
paras.zh: 这条规定本意是解决贫困家庭或家庭环境混乱的学生在完成作业时可能遇到的困难。但这项政策既不清楚，也自相矛盾。当然，不该布置学生无法独立完成、或没有昂贵设备就做不了的作业。但如果学区实质上是在放那些因家庭生活复杂而不做作业的学生一马，那它就危险地接近于暗示：对贫困孩子应当降低标准。

paras.en: District administrators say that homework will still be a part of schooling; teachers are allowed to assign as much of it as they want. But with homework counting for no more than 10% of their grades, students can easily skip half their homework and see very little difference on their report cards. Some students might do well on state tests without completing their homework, but what about the students who performed well on the tests and did their homework? It is quite possible that the homework helped. Yet rather than empowering teachers to find what works best for their students, the policy imposes a flat, across-the-board rule.
paras.zh: 学区管理者说，作业仍将是学校教育的一部分；教师想布置多少就可以布置多少。但既然作业在成绩中最多只占 10%，学生大可以轻易跳过一半作业，而成绩单上几乎看不出差别。有些学生不做作业也能在州考中取得好成绩，可那些既考得好又做了作业的学生呢？作业很可能起了作用。然而，这项政策并没有赋予教师权力去找到最适合其学生的做法，而是强加了一条一刀切的规定。

paras.en: At the same time, the policy addresses none of the truly thorny questions about homework. If the district finds homework to be unimportant to its students' academic achievement, it should move to reduce or eliminate the assignments, not make them count for almost nothing. Conversely, if homework matters, it should account for a significant portion of the grade. Meanwhile, this policy does nothing to ensure that the homework students receive is meaningful or appropriate to their age and the subject, or that teachers are not assigning more than they are willing to review and correct.
paras.zh: 与此同时，这项政策没有触及任何关于作业的真正棘手的问题。如果学区认为作业对学生的学业成绩无关紧要，那就应当着手减少甚至取消作业，而不是让它几乎不算分。反过来，如果作业确实重要，它就应当在成绩中占相当大的比重。此外，这项政策也完全不能保证学生拿到的作业是有意义的、与其年龄和科目相适应的，也不能保证教师布置的作业没有超出他们愿意批改的数量。

paras.en: The homework rules should be put on hold while the school board, which is responsible for setting educational policy, looks into the matter and conducts public hearings. It is not too late for L.A. Unified to do homework right.
paras.zh: 在负责制定教育政策的教育委员会调查此事并举行公开听证会期间，这些作业规定应当暂缓执行。洛杉矶联合学区要把作业这件事做对，现在还不算太晚。

items.stem: It is implied in Paragraph 1 that nowadays homework
opts: is no longer an educational ritual
is not required for advanced courses
items.exp: 定位第一段①句 in recent years it has been particularly scorned，scorned（被鄙弃）与 more criticism 同义，首句 never been terribly popular 只是铺垫。B 的 gaining more preferences 与“尤其遭鄙弃”相反；C 把 are revising their thinking on this educational ritual 曲解成“不再是惯例”，原文只是说在重新审视。

items.stem: L.A. Unified has made the rule about homework mainly because poor students
opts: tend to have moderate expectations for their education
have asked for a different educational standard
may have problems finishing their homework
have voiced their complaints about homework
items.exp: 定位第二段①句 This rule is meant to address the difficulty that students from impoverished or chaotic homes might have in completing their homework，即贫困或家庭混乱的学生“完成作业有困难”，C 是原句的同义改写。A、D 文中无据；B 把作者担心的“降低标准”误当成学生的诉求。

items.stem: According to Paragraph 3, one problem with the policy is that it may
opts: result in students' indifference to their report cards
undermine the authority of state tests
items.exp: 定位第三段②句 with homework counting for no more than 10% of their grades, students can easily skip half their homework：作业只占 10%，学生可以随手跳过一半，正是打击了做作业的动力，故 D。C 与同段①句 teachers are allowed to assign as much of it as they want 相悖——布置权并未被限制。

items.stem: As mentioned in Paragraph 4, a key question unanswered about homework is whether
opts: it places extra burdens on teachers
items.exp: 定位第四段①至③句：政策回避了 thorny questions，作者用 If... it should move to reduce or eliminate... Conversely, if homework matters, it should account for a significant portion of the grade 正反两说，可见悬而未决的是“作业到底重不重要”，故 B。A 只是假设情形下的一种处置办法，D 把“对学业成就重要”窄化成“对分数重要”，都是设陷。

items.stem: A suitable title for this text could be
opts: A Welcomed Policy for Poor Students
Wrong Interpretations of an Educational Policy
items.exp: 全文先摆出 L.A. Unified 的新规，再从“等于给贫困生降标准”“学生可跳过一半作业”“回避真问题”三层批评，末段要求暂缓并开听证会，落点是这条政策方法有误，A 正确。C 只覆盖第四段，以偏概全；B 与全文批评基调相反；D 的“误解”并非作者所指。

sections.title: Text 2　粉色与女孩身份的建构
sections.dir: Read the following four texts. Answer the questions after each text by choosing A, B, C or D. Mark your answers on ANSWER SHEET 1. (40 points)
sections.note: 主线：粉色是营销造出来的，不是女孩天性。26 题的 tiny slice of the rainbow 意为“只是女孩气质的一小部分”。

paras.en: Pretty in pink: adult women do not remember being so obsessed with the colour, yet it is pervasive in our young girls' lives. It is not that pink is intrinsically bad, but it is such a tiny slice of the rainbow and, though it may celebrate girlhood in one way, it also repeatedly and firmly fuses girls' identity to appearance. Then it presents that connection, even among two-year-olds, between girls as not only innocent but as evidence of innocence. Looking around, I despaired at the singular lack of imagination about girls' lives and interests.
paras.zh: 穿粉色好看：成年女性不记得自己曾如此痴迷这种颜色，可它在幼女的生活中无处不在。粉色本身并非不好，但它只是彩虹中极小的一片；尽管它以某种方式颂扬了女孩气质，却也一再牢牢地把女孩的身份粘合到外表上。随后它又把女孩之间的这种关联——甚至在两岁孩子之间——呈现为不仅是天真无邪，而且天真的证据。环顾四周，我对人们谈起女孩的生活与兴趣时那种出奇的缺乏想象力感到绝望。

paras.en: Girls' attraction to pink may seem unavoidable, somehow encoded in their DNA, but according to Jo Paoletti, an associate professor of American Studies, it is not. Children were not colour-coded at all until the early 20th century: in the era before domestic washing machines all babies wore white as a practical matter, since the only way of getting clothes clean was to boil them. What's more, both boys and girls wore what were thought of as gender-neutral dresses. When nursery colours were introduced, pink was actually considered the more masculine colour, a pastel version of red, which was associated with strength. Blue, with its intimations of the Virgin Mary, constancy and faithfulness, symbolised femininity. It was not until the mid-1980s, when amplifying age and sex differences became a dominant children's marketing strategy, that pink fully came into its own, when it began to seem inherently attractive to girls, part of what defined them as female, at least for the first few critical years.
paras.zh: 女孩对粉色的偏爱看似不可避免，仿佛写在她们的 DNA 里，但美国研究副教授乔·保莱蒂（Jo Paoletti）认为并非如此。直到 20 世纪初，儿童才被按颜色区分：在家用洗衣机出现之前，所有婴儿都穿白色，这是出于实用——当时把衣服弄干净的唯一办法就是煮洗。而且，男孩女孩都穿被认为是性别中性的衣服。育儿色彩被引入时，粉色其实被视为更男性化的颜色，是红色的柔和版，而红色与力量相关。蓝色因其让人联想到圣母马利亚、恒久与忠诚，象征女性气质。直到 20 世纪 80 年代中期，放大年龄与性别差异成为儿童营销的主导策略，粉色才真正盛行起来，从那时起它开始显得对女孩有天然的吸引力，成为界定她们为女性的部分内容——至少在最初几个关键年头如此。

paras.en: I had not realised how profoundly marketing trends dictated our perception of what is natural to kids, including our core beliefs about their psychological development. Take the toddler. I assumed that phase was something experts developed after years of research into children's behaviour: wrong. Turns out, according to Daniel Cook, a historian of childhood consumerism, it was popularised as a marketing trick by clothing manufacturers in the 1930s.
paras.zh: 我原先没有意识到，营销潮流在多大程度上左右着我们对“孩子天生如何”的看法，包括我们对儿童心理发展的核心信念。以“幼儿”为例。我原以为这个阶段是专家们对儿童行为多年研究之后才提出的：错了。按照儿童消费史学者丹尼尔·库克（Daniel Cook）的说法，它是 20 世纪 30 年代由服装厂商作为一种营销手段推广开来的。

paras.en: Trade publications counselled department stores that, in order to increase sales, they should create a "third stepping stone" between infant wear and older kids' clothes. It was only after "toddler" became a common shoppers' term that it evolved into a broadly accepted developmental stage. Splitting kids, or adults, into ever-tinier categories has proved a sure-fire way to boost profits. And one of the easiest ways to segment a market is to magnify gender differences — or invent them where they did not previously exist.
paras.zh: 行业刊物建议百货商店，为提高销量，应在婴儿装和大童装之间设置“第三级台阶”。直到“幼儿”成为购物者的常用词之后，它才演变成一个被广泛接受的发展阶段。把孩子或成人不断切分成更细小的类别，已被证明是提高利润的万无一失之法。而细分市场最容易的办法之一，就是放大性别差异——或者在原本不存在差异的地方造出差异。

items.stem: By saying "it is...the rainbow" (Line 3, Para. 1), the author means pink
opts: cannot explain girls' lack of imagination
should not be associated with girls' innocence
should not be the sole representation of girlhood
cannot influence girls' lives and interests
items.exp: 定位第一段②句 it is such a tiny slice of the rainbow and, though it may celebrate girlhood in one way, it also...：彩虹的一小片即“女孩气质中极小的一部分”，加上“把女孩身份绑到外表上”的批评，可见作者反对把粉色当作女孩的唯一代表，C 正确。A、D 把批评对象错置到“想象力”“影响力”上，B 针对的是③句的 innocence。

items.stem: According to Paragraph 2, which of the following is true of colours?
opts: Colours are encoded in girls' DNA.
Blue used to be regarded as the colour for girls.
Pink used to be a neutral colour in symbolising genders.
items.exp: 定位第二段⑤句 Blue, with its intimations of the Virgin Mary, constancy and faithfulness, symbolised femininity——蓝色曾象征女性气质，故 B。A 被段首 it is not 直接否定；C 是对 all babies wore white 的误读，穿白是为了耐煮洗，不是“偏爱”；D 与④句 pink was actually considered the more masculine colour 相反。

items.stem: The author suggests that our perception of children's psychological development was much influenced by
opts: the marketing of products for children
items.exp: 定位第三段①句 marketing trends dictated our perception of what is natural to kids, including our core beliefs about their psychological development，②至④句又以 toddler 为例说明它是 clothing manufacturers 的 marketing trick，故 B。C 正是被推翻的“专家多年研究”的假设；A、D 把手段（观察、消费史研究）误当成影响源。

items.stem: We may learn from Paragraph 4 that department stores were advised to
opts: attach equal importance to different genders
focus on infant wear and older kids' clothes
items.exp: 定位第四段①③句：建议是在婴儿装与大童装之间加“第三级台阶”，紧接着③句点明 Splitting kids, or adults, into ever-tinier categories has proved a sure-fire way to boost profits，即把消费者切成更小的群体，A 正确。C 是“在两类之间增设一档”，不是“只做这两类”；D 把 shoppers' term 这一结果当成了建议。

items.stem: It can be concluded that girls' attraction to pink seems to be
opts: clearly explained by their inborn tendency
items.exp: 定位第二段末句：粉色直到 20 世纪 80 年代中期，因“放大年龄与性别差异”成为营销策略才 fully came into its own；第四段末句又说 magnify gender differences — or invent them，可见女孩对粉色的偏爱主要是商家为利润制造出来的，C 正确。B 被 it is not 否定；A、D 与全文批评营销与“专家说法”的口吻相反。

sections.title: Text 3　基因专利之争
sections.dir: Read the following four texts. Answer the questions after each text by choosing A, B, C or D. Mark your answers on ANSWER SHEET 1. (40 points)
sections.note: 主线：基因能否专利的司法拉锯。33 题的 connecting the dots 指“研究基因如何相互作用”，别按字面理解。

paras.en: In 2010, a federal judge shook America's biotech industry to its core. Companies had won patents for isolated DNA for decades — by 2005 some 20% of human genes were patented. But in March 2010 a judge ruled that genes were unpatentable. Executives were violently agitated. The Biotechnology Industry Organisation (BIO), a trade group, assured members that this was just a "preliminary step" in a longer battle.
paras.zh: 2010 年，一位联邦法官震动了整个美国生物技术产业。几十年来，企业一直能就分离出的 DNA 获得专利——到 2005 年，约 20% 的人类基因已被授予专利。但 2010 年 3 月，一位法官裁定基因不可授予专利。企业高管们极为不安。行业组织“生物技术产业组织”（BIO）向会员保证，这只是漫长争斗中的“第一步”。

paras.en: On July 29th they were relieved, at least temporarily. A federal appeals court overturned the prior decision, ruling that Myriad Genetics could indeed hold patents to two genes that help forecast a woman's risk of breast cancer. The chief executive of Myriad, a company in Utah, said the ruling was a blessing to firms and patients alike.
paras.zh: 7 月 29 日，他们松了一口气，至少暂时如此。一家联邦上诉法院推翻了先前的裁定，判定 Myriad 基因公司确实可以持有两项有助于预测女性乳腺癌风险的基因专利。这家位于犹他州的公司首席执行官说，这一裁定对企业与患者都是福音。

paras.en: But as companies continue their attempts at personalised medicine, the courts will remain rather busy. The Myriad case itself is probably not over. Critics make three main arguments against gene patents: a gene is a product of nature, so it may not be patented; gene patents suppress innovation rather than reward it; and patents' monopolies restrict access to genetic tests such as Myriad's. A growing number seem to agree. Last year a federal task-force urged reform for patents related to genetic tests. In October the Department of Justice filed a brief in the Myriad case, arguing that an isolated DNA molecule "is no less a product of nature... than are cotton fibres that have been separated from cotton seeds."
paras.zh: 但随着企业继续尝试个性化医疗，法院仍将相当忙碌。Myriad 案本身很可能并未了结。批评者提出三条反对基因专利的主要理由：基因是自然产物，因此不应被授予专利；基因专利压制而非奖励创新；专利垄断限制了人们获得 Myriad 之类基因检测的机会。同意者似乎越来越多。去年，一个联邦特别工作组敦促改革与基因检测相关的专利。10 月，司法部在 Myriad 案中提交意见书，主张分离出的 DNA 分子“同从棉籽上分离出的棉纤维一样，都是自然产物”。

paras.en: Despite the appeals court's decision, big questions remain unanswered. For example, it is unclear whether the sequencing of a whole genome violates the patents of individual genes within it. The case may yet reach the Supreme Court.
paras.zh: 尽管上诉法院已作出裁决，重大问题仍未得到解答。例如，对完整基因组进行测序是否侵犯其中单个基因的专利，目前尚不清楚。此案仍可能上诉至最高法院。

paras.en: As the industry advances, however, other suits may have an even greater impact. Companies are unlikely to file many more patents for human DNA molecules — most are already patented or in the public domain. Firms are now studying how genes interact, looking for correlations that might be used to determine the causes of disease or predict a drug's efficacy. Companies are eager to win patents for "connecting the dots," explains Hans Sauer, a lawyer for the BIO.
paras.zh: 然而，随着产业向前发展，其他诉讼可能影响更大。企业不太可能再就人类 DNA 分子提交大量专利申请——多数已经获得专利或已进入公共领域。企业现在正研究基因如何相互作用，寻找可用于确定病因或预测药效的关联性。BIO 的律师汉斯·绍尔（Hans Sauer）解释说，企业急于就“把点连起来”获得专利。

paras.en: Their success may be determined by a suit related to this issue, brought by the Mayo Clinic, which the Supreme Court will hear in its next term. The BIO recently held a convention which included sessions to coach lawyers on the shifting landscape for patents. Each meeting was packed.
paras.zh: 它们能否成功，可能取决于 Mayo 诊所就这一问题提起的一起诉讼，最高法院将在下一开庭期审理。BIO 最近召开大会，其中一些专场就不断变化的专利形势对律师进行培训。每场会议都座无虚席。

items.stem: It can be learned from Paragraph 1 that the biotech companies would like
opts: the BIO to issue a warning
judges to rule out gene patenting
items.exp: 定位第一段③④句 a judge ruled that genes were unpatentable. Executives were violently agitated——裁定基因不可专利，业界“极为不安”，反推他们希望基因可以专利，A 正确。D 说“法官排除基因专利”，恰是他们最反对的结果；B、C 于文无据。

items.stem: Those who are against gene patents believe that
opts: patents on genes depend much on innovation
courts should restrict access to genetic tests
items.exp: 定位第三段③句 Critics make three main arguments: a gene is a product of nature, so it may not be patented，既然“自然产物不可专利”，其反面即只有人造之物才可专利，B 正确。A 与“只质疑检测的可及性”不符；C 与 gene patents suppress innovation 相反；D 把“专利垄断限制检测”换成了“法院应限制检测”。

items.stem: According to Hans Sauer, companies are eager to win patents for
items.exp: 定位第五段③④句 Firms are now studying how genes interact, looking for correlations... Companies are eager to win patents for "connecting the dots"——connecting the dots 回指上句“研究基因如何相互作用”，A 正确。B 把 correlations 误读为“疾病之间的关联”；C 是对比喻字面义的曲解；D 与②句“人类 DNA 专利难再申请”相反。

items.stem: By saying "Each meeting was packed" (Line 4, Para. 6), the author means that
opts: the BIO was a powerful organisation
gene patenting was a great concern
lawyers were keen to attend conventions
items.exp: 定位末段②③句：BIO 召开大会，设专场就 the shifting landscape for patents 培训律师，Each meeting was packed 是场场爆满，说明业界对基因专利前景高度关注，C 正确。B 是最强干扰——爆满的原因是议题重大，而非 BIO 本身强大；D 只停留在律师这一表层。

items.stem: Generally speaking, the author's attitude toward gene patenting is
items.exp: 全文并列呈现三方：公司要专利、批评者三条理由、司法部与上诉法院的不同立场，作者只陈述各方，未表态，D 正确。A、C 把第三段批评者的观点当成作者态度；B 把首段企业的立场当成作者立场，同属张冠李戴。

sections.title: Text 4　经济衰退的长远影响
sections.dir: Read the following four texts. Answer the questions after each text by choosing A, B, C or D. Mark your answers on ANSWER SHEET 1. (40 points)
sections.note: 主线：高失业时代的长期影响。38 题的“人性之恶”概括了 mean-spirited 与种族、阶层冲突；A 只讲移民。

paras.en: The great recession may be over, but this era of high joblessness is probably beginning. Before it ends, it will likely change the life course and character of a generation of young adults. And ultimately, it is likely to reshape our politics, our culture, and the character of our society for years.
paras.zh: 大衰退也许已经结束，但这个高失业率的时代很可能才刚刚开始。在它结束之前，它可能改变一代年轻人的生命轨迹与性格。而最终，它可能在多年之内重塑我们的政治、文化以及我们社会的性格。

paras.en: No one tries harder than the jobless to find silver linings in this national economic disaster. Many said that unemployment, while extremely painful, had improved them in some ways: they had become less materialistic and more financially prudent; they were more aware of the struggles of others. In limited respects, perhaps the recession will leave society better off. At the very least, it has awoken us from our national fever dream of easy riches and bigger houses, and put a necessary end to an era of reckless personal spending.
paras.zh: 在这场全国性的经济灾难中，没有人比失业者更努力地去寻找一线光明。许多人说，失业虽然极其痛苦，却在某些方面改善了他们：他们变得不那么看重物质，理财更加谨慎；也更体察他人的艰难。在有限的方面，衰退或许会让社会变得更好。至少，它把我们从这个国家“轻松致富、住更大房子”的狂热梦境中唤醒，为一个肆意消费的时代画上了必要的句号。

paras.en: But for the most part, these benefits seem thin, uncertain, and far off. In The Moral Consequences of Economic Growth, the economic historian Benjamin Friedman argues that both inside and outside the U.S., lengthy periods of economic stagnation or decline have almost always left society more mean-spirited and less inclusive, and have usually stopped or reversed the advance of rights and freedoms. Anti-immigrant sentiment typically increases, as does conflict between races and classes.
paras.zh: 但在大多数方面，这些好处显得微薄、不确定且遥远。经济史学家本杰明·弗里德曼（Benjamin Friedman）在《经济增长的道德后果》一书中论证说，无论在美国国内还是国外，长期的经济停滞或衰退几乎总是让社会变得更刻薄、更不包容，并且通常使权利与自由的进步停滞甚至倒退。反移民情绪通常会高涨，种族与阶层之间的冲突也是如此。

paras.en: Income inequality usually falls during a recession, but it has not shrunk in this one. Indeed, this period of economic weakness may reinforce class divides, and decrease opportunities to cross them — especially for young people. The research of Till Von Wachter, the economist at Columbia University, suggests that not all people graduating into a recession see their life chances dimmed: those with degrees from elite universities catch up fairly quickly to where they otherwise would have been if they had graduated in better times; it is the masses beneath them that are left behind.
paras.zh: 收入不平等通常在衰退期间会缩小，但这一次并没有。事实上，这段经济疲弱期可能强化阶层鸿沟，并减少跨越鸿沟的机会——对年轻人尤其如此。哥伦比亚大学经济学家蒂尔·冯·瓦赫特（Till Von Wachter）的研究表明，并非所有在经济衰退中毕业的人都看到自己的人生机会变得黯淡：那些拥有名校学位的人很快就能追赶到“若在好年景毕业本应达到”的位置；被落下的是他们之下的普通大众。

paras.en: In the Internet age, it is particularly easy to see the resentment that has always been hidden within American society. More difficult, in the moment, is discerning precisely how these lean times are affecting society's character. In many respects, the U.S. was more socially tolerant entering this recession than at any time in its history, and a variety of national polls on social conflict since then have shown mixed results. We will have to wait and see exactly how these hard times will reshape our social fabric. But they certainly will reshape it, and all the more so the longer they extend.
paras.zh: 在互联网时代，人们特别容易看到一直隐藏在美国社会中的怨恨。此时更难的是准确辨明这些艰难时世正在如何影响社会的性格。在许多方面，美国进入这轮衰退时比历史上任何时期都更社会宽容，此后各种关于社会冲突的全国性民调结果也是喜忧参半。我们只能等待，看这些艰难岁月究竟会如何重塑我们的社会结构。但它们必定会重塑它，而且持续得越久，重塑得越彻底。

items.stem: By saying "to find silver linings" (Line 1, Para. 2) the author suggests that the jobless try to
opts: make profits from the troubled economy
look on the bright side of the recession
items.exp: 定位第二段①②句 No one tries harder than the jobless to find silver linings...: Many said that unemployment... had improved them in some ways。silver linings 指“困境中的一线光明”，即从坏处看好的一面，D 正确。A 的补贴、B 的牟利、C 的探究原因，都与后文“变得不那么物质化”的语境不合。

items.stem: According to Paragraph 2, the recession has made people
items.exp: 定位第二段②③句 they had become less materialistic and more financially prudent，以及“从轻松致富、住大房子的迷梦中醒来”，可见人们被促使重新审视自己的生活方式，D 正确。A 的相互争斗是第三段弗里德曼所述后果；B 与“从迷梦中醒来”相反；C 与“更谨慎”矛盾。

items.stem: Benjamin Friedman believes that economic recessions may
opts: impose a heavier burden on immigrants
bring out more evils of human nature
promote the advance of rights and freedoms
ease conflicts between races and classes
items.exp: 定位第三段②③句：长期停滞或衰退几乎总让社会 more mean-spirited and less inclusive，且 Anti-immigrant sentiment typically increases, as does conflict between races and classes，即衰退放大人性中的恶意，B 正确。C、D 与 stopped or reversed the advance、冲突加剧相反；A 只说移民，覆盖不了“刻薄、不包容、种族冲突”。

items.stem: The research of Till Von Wachter suggests that in the recession graduates from elite universities tend to
opts: lag behind the others due to decreased opportunities
catch up quickly with experienced employees
see their life chances as dimmed as the others'
recover more quickly than the others
items.exp: 定位第四段③句 those with degrees from elite universities catch up fairly quickly to where they otherwise would have been if they had graduated in better times，即名校毕业生较快回到本应达到的位置，D 正确。A、C 说的是被落下的 the masses beneath them；B 把参照对象换成“有经验的员工”，原文比的是“景气年景毕业的自己”。

items.stem: The author thinks that the influence of hard times on society is
items.exp: 定位末段④⑤句 We will have to wait and see exactly how these hard times will reshape our social fabric. But they certainly will reshape it——方式待观察，但“必定会重塑”，故 certain。A 与首段 reshape our politics, our culture 冲突；D 语气过重，作者只说方向未定，未断言破坏性。

sections.title: Section II Part B　多项对应（人物与观点匹配）
sections.dir: Read the following text and answer the questions by finding information from the left column that corresponds to each of the marked details given in the right column. There are two extra choices in the right column. Mark your answers on ANSWER SHEET 1. (10 points)
sections.note: 主线：史学从“伟人传记”一路转向“自下而上的历史”。多余项 B、D 分别把“公众荣耀”和“新领域”安到错的人头上。
subs: emphasized the virtue of classical heroes.
highlighted the public glory of the leading artists.
focused on epochal figures whose lives were hard to imitate.
opened up new realms of understanding the great men in history.
held that history should be the story of the masses and their record of struggle.
dismissed virtue as unnecessary for successful leaders.
depicted the worthy lives of engineers, industrialists and explorers.
sections.intro:
"Universal history, the history of what man has accomplished in this world, is at bottom the History of the Great Men who have worked here," wrote the Victorian sage Thomas Carlyle. Well, not any more it is not.

Suddenly, Britain looks to have fallen out with its favorite historical form. This could be no more than a passing literary craze, but it also points to a broader truth about how we now approach the past: less concerned with learning from our forefathers and more interested in feeling their pain. Today, we want empathy, not inspiration.

From the earliest days of the Renaissance, the writing of history meant recounting the exemplary lives of great men. In 1337, Petrarch began work on his rambling writing De Viris Illustribus — On Famous Men, highlighting the virtus (or virtue) of classical heroes. Petrarch celebrated their greatness in conquering fortune and rising to the top. This was the biographical tradition which Niccolo Machiavelli turned on its head. In The Prince, he championed cunning, ruthlessness, and boldness, rather than virtue, mercy and justice, as the skills of successful leaders.

Over time, the attributes of greatness shifted. The Romantics commemorated the leading painters and authors of their day, stressing the uniqueness of the artist's personal experience rather than public glory. By contrast, the Victorian author Samuel Smiles wrote Self-Help as a catalogue of the worthy lives of engineers, industrialists and explorers. "The valuable examples which they furnish of the power of self-help, of patient purpose, resolute working, and steadfast integrity, issuing in the formation of truly noble and manly character, exhibit," wrote Smiles, "what it is in the power of each to accomplish for himself." His biographies of James Watt, Richard Arkwright and Josiah Wedgwood were held up as beacons to guide the working man through his difficult life.

This was all a bit bourgeois for Thomas Carlyle, who focused his biographies on the truly heroic lives of Martin Luther, Oliver Cromwell and Napoleon Bonaparte. These epochal figures represented lives hard to imitate, but to be acknowledged as possessing higher authority than mere mortals.

Not everyone was convinced by such bombast. "The history of all hitherto existing society is the history of class struggles," wrote Marx and Engels in The Communist Manifesto. For them, history did nothing, it possessed no immense wealth nor waged battles: "It is man, real, living man who does all that." And history should be the story of the masses and their record of struggle. As such, it needed to appreciate the economic realities, the social contexts and power relations in which each epoch stood. For: "Men make their own history, but they do not make it just as they please; they do not make it under circumstances chosen by themselves, but under circumstances directly found, given and transmitted from the past."

This was the tradition which revolutionised our appreciation of the past. In place of Thomas Carlyle, Britain nurtured Christopher Hill, EP Thompson and Eric Hobsbawm. History from below stood alongside biographies of great men. Whole new realms of understanding — from gender to race to cultural studies — were opened up as scholars unpicked the multiplicity of lost societies. And it transformed public history too: downstairs became just as fascinating as upstairs.

blocks.exp: 定位第三段②③句：彼特拉克写《名人传》，highlighting the virtus (or virtue) of classical heroes，又颂扬他们征服命运、登上顶峰之伟大，A 的 emphasized the virtue of classical heroes 正是原句同义。D 的最强干扰在末段“新领域”，那是后世“自下而上的历史”学者打开的，与他无关。

定位第三段⑤句 he championed cunning, ruthlessness, and boldness, rather than virtue, mercy and justice, as the skills of successful leaders——把“美德”从成功领导者的必备条件中剔除，正是 F 的 dismissed virtue as unnecessary。A 是彼特拉克的主张，恰是马基雅维利要“扭转”的那一套。

定位第四段③句 the Victorian author Samuel Smiles wrote Self-Help as a catalogue of the worthy lives of engineers, industrialists and explorers，worthy lives 与 G 的 depicted the worthy lives 直接对应，故 G。C 的“难以效仿的时代人物”是卡莱尔笔下的路德、克伦威尔、拿破仑，不是斯迈尔斯。

定位第五段②句 These epochal figures represented lives hard to imitate, but to be acknowledged as possessing higher authority than mere mortals，epochal figures 与 lives hard to imitate 两个关键词与 C 完全重合。B 的 public glory 是第四段“浪漫派”的反面（他们强调个人体验而非公众荣耀），与卡莱尔无关。
定位第六段④句 And history should be the story of the masses and their record of struggle，与 E 逐词对应。D 是末段的干扰——opened up whole new realms 说的是后来性别、种族、文化研究等“自下而上”的史学，不是《共产党宣言》作者的原话，且 D 限定为 the great men，方向相反。

sections.title: Section III　翻译
sections.dir: Translate the following text from English into Chinese. Write your translation on ANSWER SHEET 2. (15 points)
sections.note: 难点：privilege 作动词是“给予优待”，brain drain 译“人才外流”，could have taught 要译出“本可以”。

paras.en: When people in developing countries worry about migration, they are usually concerned at the prospect of their best and brightest departure to Silicon Valley or to hospitals and universities in the developed world. These are the kind of workers that countries like Britain, Canada and Australia try to attract by using immigration rules that privilege college graduates.
paras.zh: 当发展中国家的人们为移民问题担忧时，他们通常忧虑的是本国最优秀、最聪明的人才可能离开，前往硅谷，或前往发达国家的医院和大学。这类人才正是英国、加拿大和澳大利亚等国试图通过给予大学毕业生优待的移民法规加以吸引的对象。

paras.en: Lots of studies have found that well-educated people from developing countries are particularly likely to emigrate. A big survey of Indian households in 2004 found that nearly 40% of emigrants had more than a high-school education, compared with around 3.3% of all Indians over the age 25. This "brain drain" has long bothered policymakers in poor countries. They fear that it hurts their economies, depriving them of much-needed skilled workers who could have taught at their universities, worked in their hospitals and come up with clever new products for their factories to make.
paras.zh: 大量研究发现，发展中国家受过良好教育的人尤其可能移居国外。2004 年一项针对印度家庭的大型调查发现，近 40% 的移居者受过高中以上的教育，而 25 岁以上的全体印度人中这一比例约为 3.3%。这种“人才外流”长期以来困扰着贫困国家的政策制定者。他们担心这会损害本国经济，使国家失去急需的技术人才——这些人本可以在本国大学任教、在医院工作，为本国工厂设计出巧妙的新产品。

sections.title: Section IV Part A　应用文（投诉信）
sections.dir: Suppose you have found something wrong with the electronic dictionary that you bought from an online store the other day. Write an email to the customer service center to 1) make a complaint, and 2) demand a prompt solution. (about 100 words)
sections.note: 两要点缺一不可：先具体说清坏在哪（屏幕闪烁、发音失灵），再给可执行的方案（换货或退款）与期限。署名 Zhang Wei。
sections.sample:
Dear Customer Service,

I am writing to complain about the electronic dictionary I ordered from your online store last week (order No. 20120315). When the parcel arrived, I found that the screen flickers whenever the device is turned on, the pronunciation function does not work at all, and several keys respond only after being pressed twice. For a product advertised as a professional learning tool, this is deeply disappointing.

I would therefore ask you to replace it or refund me in full within ten days, and to tell me how to return the item.

I look forward to your prompt reply.

Yours sincerely,
Zhang Wei
tips: 首句直接点明“投诉＋所购商品＋订单号”，不要用 I am writing to you 空转开头
故障要具体可感（屏幕闪烁、发音失灵、按键不灵），三个细节比一句 it doesn't work 更有说服力
第 2 个要点必须落到方案与期限（replace or refund within ten days），只抱怨不提要求会直接丢分
结尾催复，署名固定 Zhang Wei，且不写地址

sections.title: Section IV Part B　图表作文
sections.dir: Write an essay based on the following table. In your writing, you should 1) describe the table, and 2) give your comments. You should write at least 150 words. (15 points)
sections.note: 表格呈“两头高、中间低”：≤40 岁满意 16.7%，41~50 岁满意 0、不满意 64.0%，>50 岁满意 40%。重点写中间层。
sections.sample:
The table, which surveys the job satisfaction of the employees of a company, tells a story that is anything but flat. Among workers aged 40 or under, only 16.7% say they are satisfied, while 33.3% are dissatisfied and exactly half are unsure. Those between 41 and 50 are the most unhappy group of all: nobody reports satisfaction, 64.0% are dissatisfied, and the remaining 36.0% have no clear idea. Satisfaction then rises sharply again with age, for 40.0% of employees over 50 are satisfied and only 10.0% are dissatisfied.

What lies behind this U-shaped pattern? The middle group usually carries the heaviest burden - families, mortgages and the most demanding duties - yet its members have probably reached a career ceiling and see little hope of promotion. Young employees, by contrast, are still learning and expect their situation to improve, while older ones have either settled into secure positions or are close to retirement, and therefore judge their jobs more mildly.

In my view, a company that ignores this gap will pay for it in efficiency. It should offer its middle-aged staff clearer promotion channels, more training and a fairer reward system, so that experience is not wasted and frustration does not spread to the young.
tips: 第一段只读数：三组人的满意率（16.7% / 0 / 40%）与不满意率（33.3% / 64.0% / 10.0%）必须成组对照，别逐格念表
第二段是拉分处：解释“中间层最不满”的两个原因——家庭与房贷压力最大、晋升到顶；再点一句年轻人与年长者的参照系不同
第三段给建议要落到管理动作（晋升通道、培训、薪酬），不要空喊“企业应重视员工”
